name: Ogtinc
summary: Ogtinc is an independent furbolg hunter perched on a high ridge overlooking the Ruins of Eldarath in Azshara. Having parted ways with his tribe to serve the balance of nature, he acts as a trusted ally and mentor for the Cenarion Circle. Skilled hunters seeking to test their craft against the fiercest beasts of Kalimdor often seek out his guidance.

sections.title: A Furbolg Apart
sections.body: While most furbolg in Kalimdor remain fiercely bound to their tribes—or have succumbed to corruption following the Third War—Ogtinc chose a distinct path. Departing from his kin, he dedicated his bow and survival lore to aiding the Cenarion Circle. He makes his camp high on a bluff southeast of Timbermaw Hold, vigilantly watching over the ancient, shattered lands of Azshara.

sections.title: Master of the Hunt
sections.body: Ogtinc is renowned among seasoned trackers for his intimate understanding of Kalimdor's wilderness. He tests hunters who have honed their skills across the continents, dispatching them to gather rare trophies—such as the antlers of courser beasts, the scale of wave-thrashed sea serpents, and parts from green dragonkin. Through these trials, he teaches that true hunting honors the natural world and preserves balance rather than mindlessly taking life.

faq.answer: Ogtinc is an accomplished furbolg hunter stationed atop the cliffs of Azshara. Unlike most of his reclusive or corrupted brethren, he left his ancestral tribe behind to offer his tracking skills and wisdom to the druids of the Cenarion Circle.
He is located in Azshara, perched on a cliffside campsite that overlooks the ancient Ruins of Eldarath, just southeast of Timbermaw Hold.

faq.q: Why did Ogtinc leave his tribe?
faq.answer: Ogtinc left his kin specifically to aid the Cenarion Circle in their efforts to preserve nature. While his precise tribal origins remain unspecified, his clear mind and peaceable demeanor stand in stark contrast to the corrupted tribes elsewhere in northern Kalimdor.

faq.q: What role does Ogtinc play for hunters?
faq.answer: Ogtinc serves as a master mentor for veteran hunters reaching the pinnacle of their training. He tasks them with tracking down fearsome beasts across Kalimdor—from swift coursers to the brood of the Green Dragonflight—to prove their mastery of the wild.

faq.q: Is Ogtinc affiliated with Timbermaw Hold?
faq.answer: While he camps near Timbermaw Hold, Ogtinc acts independently in direct partnership with the Cenarion Circle. He is naturally friendly toward travelers who approach peacefully, regardless of their standing with the Timbermaw tribe.

faq.q: Why does Ogtinc watch over the Ruins of Eldarath?
faq.answer: His vantage point high above the ruins gives him an unobstructed view of the troubled wilderness below, where naga, elementals, and lingering magical echoes threaten the delicate balance of the coastal forest.

angles.text: Ogtinc offers deep spiritual and practical trials for seasoned hunters, testing their marksmanship and survival skills against Kalimdor's deadliest creatures.
As a steadfast partner of the Cenarion Circle, Ogtinc represents a rare bridge between the wild wisdom of uncorrupted furbolgs and the stewardship of the druids.
